title: Memory instruction selection
statement: Let $A$ assign an instruction to each program node. For a state consisting of a program node and a phase, the selector returns the instruction assigned at that node exactly when the phase is the start phase and the assigned instruction is a memory instruction; in every other state it returns no instruction.
